column2: Dawn, soft cool pink light. A cosy clay Vietnamese kitchen. A clay kettle on a small gas stove starts to steam. Hun stands on a small wooden-clay stool next to the stove and turns the stove knob off with its beak. A hand in a sage-green cardigan sleeve with a jade bangle reaches for a cup in the soft-focus background. Wide shot.
column3: f02: Hun leans toward the knob. f03: beak touches the knob. f04: knob turned a little, flame smaller. f05: flame out, steam still rising. f06: Hun straightens up on the stool. f07: Hun glances toward the cup on the shelf. f08: tiny settle.

column2: Dawn light. A clay breakfast table. Two hands in a sage-green cardigan sleeve with a jade bangle hold a cream clay coffee cup, tired posture. A clay smartphone lies on the table, its screen glowing with a row of seven small round faces from sad (blue) to happy (pink), icons only, no text. Hun stands next to a small sugar jar on the table, looking up at the hands. Medium shot.
column3: f02: steam from the cup curls. f03: one hand lets go of the cup and moves toward the phone. f04: the hand hovers above the phone. f05: Hun tilts its head. f06: Hun blinks. f07: the thumb touches the phone screen edge. f08: tiny settle.

column2: Close-up on the clay smartphone on the breakfast table: an index finger (sage-green cardigan sleeve) slides across the row of seven faces and stops on the fifth face (small smile), which glows softly. Hun at the edge of the frame gives a small happy nod. Steam from the cup in the background.
column3: f02: finger at the third face. f03: finger at the fourth face. f04: finger on the fifth face. f05: the fifth face glows. f06: Hun nods down. f07: Hun nods back up, small smile. f08: tiny settle.

column2: Noon, bright white light in stripes through clay window shutters. A clay living room. An arm in a navy-and-white striped shirt sleeve with a brown leather watch rests on an armchair, a folded clay newspaper lying across it, the man is dozing (only arm and sleeve visible). A clay phone on the side table vibrates, its screen shows a bell icon and a pill icon (no text). Hun waddles quickly across the tiled floor toward the side table. Medium-wide shot.
column3: f02: phone shifted a little left with two tiny clay vibration marks. f03: phone shifted right; Hun takes a step. f04: Hun takes another step. f05: Hun closer, one foot forward. f06: Hun reaches the table leg. f07: Hun looks up at the phone. f08: tiny settle.

column2: Noon light. Hun hugs a small clay glass of water against its belly (short stubby flippers, never stretched) and pushes a colourful seven-compartment clay pill organiser toward a hand in a navy-and-white striped sleeve with a brown leather watch, which reaches down to take a pill. Medium close-up.
column3: f02: Hun shuffles forward with the glass. f03: the organiser slides a little toward the hand. f04: the hand lowers toward the organiser. f05: fingers pick a small pill. f06: the hand takes the glass from Hun's belly. f07: Hun steps back, pleased. f08: tiny settle.

column2: Noon light. A table: an arm in a navy-and-white striped sleeve wears a clay blood pressure cuff connected to a small clay monitor whose screen shows only a small green heart icon. A clay phone on a little stand shows a video call screen with a picture of a small countryside clay house (no face). Hun sits beside the monitor, watching it closely. Medium shot.
column3: f02: the cuff puffs up slightly. f03: the cuff puffs more. f04: the monitor's heart icon blinks. f05: the cuff relaxes. f06: Hun leans toward the monitor. f07: Hun looks toward the phone and smiles. f08: tiny settle.

column2: Late afternoon, warm golden-orange light from the door. A clay kitchen table. Two hands in a sage-green cardigan sleeve with a jade bangle set down a woven clay market basket full of clay vegetables, a bunch of greens on top. Hun peeks out from behind the bunch of greens, curious. Medium shot.
column3: f02: basket lowered a bit more. f03: basket touches the table, greens wobble. f04: hands let go. f05: Hun's head pops out a little more. f06: Hun's eyes widen. f07: Hun looks up at the hands. f08: tiny settle.

column2: Golden light. Close on the kitchen table: Hun hugs a clay smartphone upright against its belly to hold it steady (short flippers). The phone screen shows a message bubble with a small coin icon (no text). An index finger in a sage-green cardigan sleeve presses on the screen. Medium close-up.
column3: f02: the finger approaches the screen. f03: fingertip touches the bubble. f04: a small green check appears on the screen. f05: Hun's eyes look down at the screen. f06: Hun smiles. f07: the finger lifts away. f08: tiny settle.

column2: Warm sunset rim light. Hun stands beside a round terracotta clay savings jar with a lotus relief and drops a golden clay coin into its slot, hugging the coin against its belly and rising on tiptoe. A hand in a sage-green cardigan sleeve with a jade bangle gently pats Hun's head. Medium close-up.
column3: f02: Hun on tiptoe, coin higher. f03: coin at the slot. f04: coin half inside. f05: coin gone; the hand comes down toward Hun's head. f06: the hand touches Hun's head; Hun squashes down happily. f07: Hun's eyes closed, smiling. f08: tiny settle.

column2: Sunday evening, warm yellow lamp light. Top-down view of a round low clay family dinner table: four bowls of rice, several clay dishes, hands reaching with chopsticks: a sage cardigan sleeve with jade bangle, a navy striped sleeve with wristwatch, a small mustard-yellow sleeve. Hun stands in the middle of the table pushing a small bowl of fish sauce toward the small mustard-yellow-sleeved hand.
column3: f02: Hun pushes the bowl a little. f03: bowl moves further. f04: the small hand reaches toward the bowl. f05: the small hand takes the bowl. f06: chopsticks of the other hands move to new dishes. f07: Hun stands upright, proud. f08: tiny settle.

column2: Warm lamp light. A small hand in a mustard-yellow sleeve holds up a clay tablet showing a simple weekly bar chart of seven pastel bars (no numbers, no text) toward a hand in a navy striped sleeve with a wristwatch. Hun stands on the table between them, beaming. Medium shot.
column3: f02: the tablet tilts toward the striped sleeve. f03: the striped-sleeve hand forms a thumbs-up. f04: thumbs-up higher. f05: Hun crouches (squash). f06: Hun does a tiny hop. f07: Hun lands, smiling. f08: tiny settle.

column2: Warm light. A wall with a clay Vietnamese tear-off lunar calendar block (no numbers or letters, just shapes). A hand in a sage cardigan sleeve with a jade bangle draws a red circle on the current page with a clay pen. Hun stands on a small stool below, holding the pen cap against its belly, looking up. Medium shot.
column3: f02: the pen starts the circle. f03: circle half drawn. f04: circle complete. f05: the hand lowers the pen toward Hun. f06: Hun lifts the cap up. f07: the cap goes onto the pen. f08: tiny settle.

column2: Night, deep blue, the house asleep. A clay bedroom with a big ceiling lamp switched on and a small warm bedside lamp. Hun stands on a stool and pulls the lamp's string switch with its beak. Medium shot.
column3: f02: Hun grabs the string with its beak. f03: Hun pulls, string lower. f04: the big light goes off; only the small bedside lamp glows warm. f05: Hun lets go of the string. f06: Hun looks toward the bed. f07: Hun steps down from the stool. f08: tiny settle.

column2: Night, warm bedside lamp. Two hands in a sage-green cardigan sleeve hold a clay phone showing a journal screen with only ruled lines and a small padlock icon (no text). In the background, Hun pushes the bedroom door half closed with its whole body. Medium shot.
column3: f02: a thumb moves on the screen. f03: a new ruled line fills with a soft squiggle (no letters). f04: the padlock icon glows. f05: the door moves a little. f06: the door half closed. f07: Hun peeks around the door. f08: tiny settle.

column2: Deep blue night with moonlight through the window. Hun curled up asleep at the foot of the bed under a tiny patchwork clay blanket, next to a glass jar full of tiny orange clay fish. The bedside lamp is off. A hand in a sage-green cardigan sleeve gently pulls the blanket up over Hun. Medium-wide shot.
column3: f02: the hand reaches toward the blanket. f03: the hand holds the blanket edge. f04: the blanket is pulled up a little. f05: blanket covers Hun to the beak; the hand moves away. f06: Hun's belly rises (breath in). f07: Hun's belly lowers, a tiny smile. f08: moonlight a touch brighter.

column2: MOVIE POSTER KEY ART, 16:9. A small Vietnamese clay alley at golden dawn, pastel shophouses, soft mist. Hun stands in the RIGHT THIRD of the frame hugging a small clay model of a cosy house with sage-green shutters against its belly; a low sun behind gives a glowing rim light. The whole LEFT HALF of the frame is calm, softly lit empty alley and wall, kept clear for a title. No text.

MOVIE POSTER KEY ART, portrait 4:5. A small Vietnamese clay alley at golden dawn. Hun stands in the upper-middle of the frame hugging a small clay model of a cosy house against its belly, rim light from a low sun. The lower 40% is calm, darker cobbled ground kept clear for a title. No text.
